notes: ACCESS: Tier (a) succeeded throughout - curl_cffi (chrome impersonation) fetched robots.txt (Allow: / for User-agent: *, no anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot/Claude-Web/Claude-User/Claude-SearchBot entry, so no tier restriction applies), sitemap.xml, and categorysitemap.xml (234 category URLs). Category listing pages are an Angular/Spartacus (SAP Commerce Cloud, brand 'freedomfurniture') SPA whose SSR HTML does not embed a rendered product grid or count (grid text stays 'Loading...' in raw HTML/DOM), so exact qty could not be read from static HTML alone; a short Playwright run (tier b) was used ONCE to observe the live network traffic and identify the real data source: the front-end calls a Coveo Commerce v2 'listing' REST endpoint (https://freedomfurnitureproduction1s4nmz28u.org.coveo.com/rest/organizations/.../commerce/v2/listing) using a short-lived bearer token obtained from https://api-prod.freedom.com.au/greenlitrest/v2/freedomfurniture/coveo/token. That token and endpoint were then called directly via curl_cffi (tier a, no browser needed) for every remaining category, each request keyed only by view.url=https://www.freedom.com.au/c/<slug> (the SPA normalizes the visited breadcrumb URL down to this short form before querying Coveo, confirmed by replaying an observed real page's exact request and reproducing its number). Every category recorded was double-checked against the SPA's own H1/live-network response for at least one representative node (e.g. Office Storage confirmed H1='Office Storage' + totalProducts=320 matching the direct API call) and against internally-consistent parent-vs-children sums (see TREE) to defend against the 'bad slug silently serves a wrong number' failure mode called out in the brief. TREE: built from the union of categorysitemap.xml (234 URLs) and the full live mega-menu link set scraped from a rendered page's <a href> list (~380 unique /c/ links), which surfaced several genuine categories missing from the sitemap (quilts, pillows, mattress-protectors-and-toppers, coverlets, blinds, chair-pads, electric-blanket, kitchen-textiles, outdoor-cover, kids-bath-linen, kids-cushions-and-throws, storage-boxes, storage-units, wardrobe-organisation, jewellery-boxes-and-trays, coat-hangers-and-wall-hooks, kids-storage, kids-organisation-furniture, office-bins) - each confirmed live (HTTP 200) before use. Parent/child completeness was cross-checked by summing children against the parent category's own Coveo total: bed-linen(952)=quilt-covers(408)+sheets-and-pillowcases(494)+coverlets(50) exact; curtains-and-accessories(117)=curtains(104)+accessories(13) exact; bathroom(246)=bath-accessories(83)+bath-mats(27)+bath-towels(111)+laundry-hampers(25, cross-tagged, already recorded once under Storage) exact; napery(175) and cushions-and-throws(701) matched children within normal stock-churn tolerance. Parent category URLs (organisation, storage-furniture, storage, bed-linen, bedding, napery, curtains-and-accessories, cushions-and-throws, bathroom, kitchen-and-tableware/c/kitchen-storage's own parent) were NOT recorded as their own rows since valid subcategories exist for each (rule: parent URL only when no subcategories). QTY: pagination.totalProducts field from the Coveo listing response for each category's own view.url - this is the same number the live rendered page shows (spot-checked via Playwright network capture), never estimated/aggregated/inferred. EXCLUDED (Textile) - Accessories (13, curtain wands/joiners/brackets/tracks = hardware, textile.md S5); Coasters (21, stone/marble/ceramic coaster sets, not textile); Pouffes (ottoman-type seating = Furniture); Bath Accessories (83, soap dispensers/tumblers/bins/decorative boxes - not textile, not primarily storage either); Robes (23, URL name is misleading - actual products are ARLINGTON/KAVOVA/MANDAGUARI 'Wardrobe' and a bookshelf, i.e. Bedroom Furniture, not bathrobes - confirmed via product samples before trusting the slug name); Furniture Protection (10, timber/leather/stone CARE and polish products, not fabric covers despite the category name); Underlays (0 products, and rug pads are a functional accessory not a textile product type in any case); Wallpaper and all rug colour/size facet pages (blue-rugs, grey-rugs, large-rug, round-rug, etc. - ~20 URLs) were treated as attribute-filtered views of the already-recorded All Rugs / Outdoor Rugs listings, not distinct category-tree nodes, to avoid duplicate/inflated rows; Kids Bedding (85, dominated by 'Lift Bed'/'Cot Bed'/'Play Ottoman' kids furniture per its own taxonomy 'Kids Beds > Kids Furniture' - the genuine textile subset is already covered separately by Nursery Bed Linen). EXCLUDED (Storage) - Storage Boxes (25) and Jewellery Boxes & Trays (36): despite the URL names, live product samples for both are 'Decorative Box'/'Decorative Bowl' items under the site's own 'Homewares > Decorator Accents > Home Accessories' taxonomy, i.e. Decorative Home Accessories, not functional storage (storage.md S24 boundary) - confirmed by inspecting actual returned product names rather than trusting the slug; Kids Storage (88) and Kids Organisation Furniture (56): both resolve under the site's own 'Kids Furniture'/'Nursery Furniture' taxonomy with dresser/bedside-table/bed-end samples - Furniture task's domain per storage.md S21 tie-break rule (explicit Furniture placement wins); Kitchen Bins (20) and Office Bins (0): waste/recycling bins, not organization storage; Office Accessories (41): a mixed catch-all (storage box, clock, serving tray, book end) with no primary storage purpose, distinct from the dedicated Office Storage category already recorded; Storage/Organisation/Storage-Furniture parent URLs: not recorded, subcategories exist for each.
